title: great app, but more features
body: i think the app is good overall, but it is lacking more features for a paid app. an example is an option to “further achieve” habits. like having the option to surpass the goal for habits and achieve more than needed, mainly for it to show on stats. it can even recompense the achiever with a star system: one star being the minimum and marking the habit as done, two stars and three stars being achieving more than what’s asked and an extra reward.
author: Jusitn10407
